comment:
Every figure the manual gives for this module checks out against the code: high pass 16Hz to 350Hz with a one-pole plus a Q of 1 biquad, which is 18dB per octave (Shape.cpp:268, 275-276); low pass 22000Hz down to 3000Hz at 12dB per octave (Shape.cpp:269, 284); shelves at 80Hz and 10000Hz and bells at 400Hz and 2500Hz, all ±15dB (Shape.cpp:270-283). The two sweepable filters are crossfaded in and out rather than switched, and the crossfade follows the knob leaving 0 (Shape.cpp:303-306, 325-338).

There are no CV inputs of any kind.
